for: Character Creation v2.0 (Shardfall v0.30); Paperdoll v1.0 (Shardfall v0.31)
history: 1.0.0 — Character Creation v2.0 (v0.30): the first seven entries, for the world sprite and the paper-doll body.

1.1.0 — Paperdoll v1.0 (v0.31): the first seven entries are unchanged and still unresolved. The paper doll now has a registered layer contract (paperdoll below); the painted layers it needs are added as six new entries. For the paper doll, the 'about 96 x 192' size in paperdoll_body is superseded by that 384 x 512 contract (versioned migration); the world sprite format is unchanged.

format.tintable: layers drawn in a neutral grey ramp so the game can tint them to the chosen colour

paperdoll.format: RGBA PNG, one file per body; grey shading with channel masks (primary, secondary, fixed) so the game tints materials; shared anchors from the manifest
paperdoll.standIn: src/paperdoll.js draws every layer procedurally (original code-drawn art) until painted PNGs exist. The stand-in does not resolve any entry in this file.
paperdoll.referenceArt: Shardfall_Paperdoll_Art_v1.zip (four flattened 384 x 512 portraits) is named by docs/handoffs/paperdoll-v1.md as the art reference. It is not in the repository and was not available to the v0.31 integration. It is a reference only, never runtime layers.

missing.what: Female traveller body: every clip and the idle atlas, same scale, anchor, frame order and timing as the male sheets
Male and female base bodies without the painted hood and cloak, so hair shows and a cloak can be a separate layer
Cloak (and raised hood) as its own tintable layer, every clip and facing
Hair layers, one per style: short, long, ponytail, pageboy, receding (male), mohawk (male), buns (female), pigtails (female); bald needs none
Facial hair layers: mustache, goatee, short beard, long beard, vandyke
Shirt and trousers as tintable layers (a skirt too, if a skirt item is added)
Front-view paper-doll body art, male and female, about 96 x 192, for the creator portrait and the equipment window
Painted paper-doll base bodies and faces, male and female, 384 x 512 RGBA on the manifest anchors, neutral linen underwear; no hair, armour or weapon baked in
Painted hair per creator style and body, back and front parts, grey ramp for tinting
Painted facial hair (male), grey ramp; the mustache part separable for the chain coif's face opening
Painted cloak, back and shoulder-drape front parts, tintable
One painted layer per wearable item id, both bodies, keeping the in-world silhouette and motifs, with primary / secondary / fixed channel masks
One painted held-weapon layer per weapon item id, grip registered on the main-hand anchor; metal head, wood haft, leather grip and string channels

fallback: Until these exist the world sprite and the equipment paper doll show the male hooded traveller recoloured for skin tone and cloak colour; the creator's portrait is an original procedural figure that shows every choice.
